ownership: agent_experimental; these gates test the authored concept and do not relabel staging as requester-owned obligations
pixel_policy: partial_is_fail; no inference of occluded required features

observable_gates.criterion: Visible face and short dark bob remain recognizably related to the supplied portrait; review face/hair only.
Outdoor evening terrace, garden/river depth and restaurant or doorway glow visibly read as a date-adjacent location.
She is plausibly seated on the bench, hips supported, leg/foot placement and torso turn physically coherent.
One hand rests beside her hip on the cushion and the other on her own knee; hands and arms are coherent and read as still resting.
Her gaze addresses the camera/viewer with a small knowing smile or visibly expectant intimate expression; this is personal attention rather than an unfocused look.
A nearby bench space visibly remains open toward the viewer, linked to her orientation as a place to join her.
Burgundy thin-strap cowl slip dress visibly drapes naturally in the seated posture and contributes to the intimate date direction.
Warm practical light describes her face and silk while cooler outdoor twilight stays subordinate; subject and invitation space are legible.

holistic_impression_criteria: Describe the native image impression before reading intensity labels.
Patient seductive anticipation addressed to the approaching viewer should lead the scene; an attractive generic bench portrait does not suffice.
The held gaze and open place should form one inviting relation, with dress and environment supporting it.
Report degree of perceived sensual expression and contextual physical plausibility separately from contract checks and human acceptance.
causality_boundary: Baseline-existing shapes are not evidence of improvement caused by post-core visual semantic data.
